scope: Present Warranty close closureRef as a blank explicit selector for the claim's current original-defect Issue or an approved exact-target Owner Decision.
implementation: CommandModal maps only warranty_claim:close_warranty_claim.closureRef to an exact single-reference select. Issue choices use the server workspace reference catalog for the latest version and filter by the immutable original claim data.issueRef objectId. Decision choices reuse completionDecisionReferenceOptions and additionally require an approved decision whose WorkItem target matches the current claim ID and version.

The selector opens blank even if any preexisting closureRef value is projected. The browser helper asserts the only nonempty option is an Issue with the claim's original Issue identity and exact current version, then selects that option through the UI and closes the actual Warranty claim.

The existing server closure gates remain authoritative. No schema, API, backend guard, common dependency, or authorization behavior changed; unapproved and nonmatching Decisions are not offered. Existing backend wrong/missing/unrelated closure proofs remain unchanged.
